parameter.label: TOP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT TOP.GRUPO AS VALUE, TOP.GRUPO AS LABEL FROM TGFTOP TOP WHERE GOLSINAL= -1 ORDER BY 1

chart.expression:
SELECT SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALOR , UFS.DESCRICAO, UFS.CODUF
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , TSICID CID , TSIUFS UFS
, VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND PAR.CODCID= CID.CODCID AND CID.UF= UFS.CODUF AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER GROUP BY UFS.DESCRICAO, UFS.CODUF ORDER BY 1 DESC

simple-value.expression: SELECT DESCRICAO FROM TSIUFS WHERE CODUF= :CODUF

chart.expression:
SELECT SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALOR,
CID.NOMECID, CID.CODCID, UFS.DESCRICAO, UFS.CODUF
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , TSICID CID , TSIUFS UFS , VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND PAR.CODCID= CID.CODCID AND CID.UF= UFS.CODUF AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND UFS.CODUF= :CODUF AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER GROUP BY UFS.DESCRICAO, UFS.CODUF, CID.NOMECID, CID.CODCID ORDER BY 1 DESC

simple-value.expression: SELECT (SELECT NOMECID FROM TSICID WHERE CODCID= :CODCID) AS NOMECID, DESCRICAO FROM TSIUFS WHERE CODUF= :CODUF

chart.expression:
SELECT SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALOR, CID.NOMECID, CID.CODCID , UFS.DESCRICAO, UFS.CODUF, PAR.NOMEPARC, PAR.CODPARC
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , TSICID CID , TSIUFS UFS , VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND PAR.CODCID= CID.CODCID AND CID.UF= UFS.CODUF AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND UFS.CODUF= :CODUF AND CID.CODCID= :CODCID AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER GROUP BY UFS.DESCRICAO, UFS.CODUF, CID.NOMECID, CID.CODCID, PAR.NOMEPARC, PAR.CODPARC ORDER BY 1 DESC

simple-value.expression: SELECT (SELECT NOMECID FROM TSICID WHERE CODCID= :CODCID) AS NOMECID, (SELECT NOMEPARC FROM TGFPAR WHERE CODPARC= :CODPARC) AS NOMEPARC, DESCRICAO FROM TSIUFS WHERE CODUF= :CODUF

grid.expression:
SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) as VALOR, VEN.APELIDO
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , TSICID CID , TSIUFS UFS , TGFVEN VEN , VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND PAR.CODCID= CID.CODCID AND CID.UF= UFS.CODUF AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND UFS.CODUF= :CODUF AND CID.CODCID= :CODCID AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER AND CAB.CODVEND= VEN.CODVEND AND PAR.CODPARC= :CODPARC
GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, VEN.APELIDO
